font.license: SIL OFL 1.1 (derived work; both upstream OFL texts are shipped with the font)

sources.name: Noto Sans JP
sources.role: Japanese base glyph set (covers the whole board document set except U+0160)

sources.name: Noto Sans
sources.role: Adds the exact U+0160 (S WITH CARON) glyph and its composite dependencies that Noto Sans JP lacks

derivation.method: fontTools instancer (wght 400 for JP; wdth 100, wght 400 for Noto Sans) to static, then glyf deepcopy of the U+0160 glyph (and its composite dependencies, prefixed 'rvc') from Noto Sans into Noto Sans JP, then name-table rename to 'Rvc License Sans' (no Noto/Source name retained)
derivation.determinism: Pinned, hash-verified inputs; instantiate variation deltas before removing tables; fixed head timestamps; two regenerated font files had identical SHA-256.

coverage.source: doom_payload/license_board/Documents (19 files) + documents.json titles + GAME-STRINGS.md section 10.5 board text

uiAdditions.note: checked: 'ソースの入手先（未公開）: SHA-256:　' (includes U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE) and button candidates 前へ 次へ 戻る 閉じる 表示 詳細 ページ 目次 10/19

notes: One renamed derived font face and one static TMP SDF atlas. The original U+0160 glyph is copied from the pinned Latin font without substitution. Both original OFL notices are documents 17 and 18.

atlas.formFeed: U+000C mapped to existing space glyph; original form-feed bytes remain in page text
